newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Kohl sees turnaround in jobs market by end of 1997.
newsitem.headline: Kohl sees turnaround in jobs market by end of 1997.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Monday that the upswing in the economy should cause a turnaround in the jobs market by the end of 1997.
In a summary of a speech to be delivered to a banking conference, he also said that continued high levels of unemployment remained the biggest single challenge facing the Bonn government.
Figures from the Federal Labour Office showed German unemployment rose by 8,000 to a seasonally adjusted 4.299 million in April, around post-war levels.
